nodes.description: Constant public PRICE = 0.08 ether used as per-token price when minting fewer than 10 tokens.
Constant public BULK_PRICE = 0.065 ether used as discounted per-token price for bulk mints.
Constant public TOTAL_SUPPLY = 9999 capping the collection size.
Constant public REVEAL_TIMESTAMP = 0 used to gate setting of startingIndexBlock.
Constant public MAX_PER_TX = 20 limiting tokens mintable per public transaction.
Constant public MAX_MINT_WHITELIST = 20 limiting whitelist mint amounts.
Mutable public MAX_TEAM_TOKENS counter for reserved team tokens, decremented on reserveCacti.
Public startingIndex used to shuffle tokenURI mapping once sale completes.
Public startingIndexBlock storing the block number used as randomness source.
Public mapping(address => Whitelist) tracking whitelisted addresses and their minted counts.
Array of whitelist addresses populated in the constructor.
Payable multisig address that receives the contract balance via claimETH.
Public boolean controlling whether public minting is enabled.
Public boolean controlling whether whitelist/private minting rules apply.
Constructor initializing ERC721 name/symbol and populating the whitelist from addrs.
Public function allowing hardcoded team addresses to mint reserved tokens, decrementing MAX_TEAM_TOKENS.
onlyOwner function updating the base URI for all tokens.
onlyOwner function toggling saleIsActive.
onlyOwner function toggling privateSaleIsActive.
Payable public mint function enforcing price, supply, whitelist and per-tx limits while minting in a loop.
onlyOwner function deriving startingIndex from blockhash of startingIndexBlock.
Public function transferring the whole contract balance to claimEthAddress.
View function returning the shuffled metadata URI for a token id.
onlyOwner function registering an address in the whitelist mapping.
View function checking whether an address is whitelisted.
Internal helper that mints a token then invokes the ERC721 receiver callback on the recipient.
Internal ERC721 mint that updates holder token sets, ownership map and emits Transfer.
Private function performing an external functionCall to the recipient's onERC721Received.
onlyOwner Ownable function transferring ownership to a new address.
View function returning the number of minted tokens.
Caller-controlled address used for whitelist checks, minting recipient and access control.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to decide when to set startingIndexBlock.
Native value transfer of address(this).balance to claimEthAddress inside claimETH.
External low-level functionCall invoking recipient's onERC721Received during safe mint/transfer.
Recipient address parameter of reserveCacti.
Amount parameter of reserveCacti, subtracted from MAX_TEAM_TOKENS.
Number of tokens requested in mintCacti, used in price and supply arithmetic.
New base URI string parameter of setBaseURI.
Token id parameter of tokenURI used to compute the shuffled id.
Local supply snapshot in reserveCacti used as mint index base.
Loop counter in reserveCacti.
Local variable holding totalSupply() before each mint in mintCacti.
Local shuffled token id computed in tokenURI.
Return flag set to true by addAddressToWhitelist.

edges.reason: claimETH compares msg.sender against claimEthAddress to gate the balance transfer.
reserveCacti authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender to hardcoded addresses.
mintCacti uses msg.sender as whitelist lookup key and mint recipient.
mintCacti depends on block.timestamp to trigger the starting index reveal logic.
mintCacti invokes _safeMint inside a loop over numberOfTokens.
_safeMint performs an external receiver call before the mint effects are finalized for the recipient.
onERC721Received callback is executed on the recipient contract, allowing re-entry.
_safeMint delegates the actual token minting to _mint.
_checkOnERC721Received issues the external receiver callback that can re-enter.
claimETH executes a native balance transfer to claimEthAddress.
amount is used in MAX_TEAM_TOKENS subtraction inside reserveCacti.
MAX_TEAM_TOKENS is read and decremented by amount in reserveCacti.
numberOfTokens participates in price multiplication and supply addition arithmetic in mintCacti.
PRICE is multiplied by numberOfTokens to validate msg.value in mintCacti.
BULK_PRICE is multiplied by numberOfTokens for bulk mints in mintCacti.
TOTAL_SUPPLY bounds the totalSupply plus numberOfTokens check in mintCacti.
whitelist mapping is read and updated for the caller in mintCacti.
saleIsActive gates whether mintCacti can proceed.
privateSaleIsActive selects whitelist versus public limits in mintCacti.
claimEthAddress is the authorized caller and transfer destination in claimETH.
startingIndex is validated and written in setStartingIndex.
startingIndexBlock is read as the blockhash randomness source in setStartingIndex.
startingIndex is added to tokenId modulo TOTAL_SUPPLY in tokenURI.
tokenId parameter is combined with startingIndex in tokenURI shifting logic.
TOTAL_SUPPLY is used as modulo bound when computing the shuffled id in tokenURI.
baseURI parameter flows into _setBaseURI inside setBaseURI.
addr parameter is the mint recipient passed to _safeMint in reserveCacti.
local supply plus loop index forms the minted token id in reserveCacti.
local loop counter i drives the reserveCacti mint loop.
local mintIndex from totalSupply() is used as the token id in mintCacti.
local moddedId is computed and forwarded to super.tokenURI in tokenURI.
local success flag is returned from addAddressToWhitelist.

normalization_plan.reason: addr parameter only exists to serve the reserveCacti minting logic.
amount parameter is consumed by the MAX_TEAM_TOKENS arithmetic in reserveCacti.
numberOfTokens parameter is fully consumed by mintCacti validation and mint loop.
baseURI parameter is passed directly to _setBaseURI by setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter is only used to compute the shuffled id inside tokenURI.
supply local is an intermediate snapshot of totalSupply used by reserveCacti.
loop counter i is a transient index of the reserveCacti mint loop.
mintIndex local is a transient snapshot of totalSupply used by mintCacti.
moddedId local is a transient computed value inside tokenURI.
success local is the return flag produced by addAddressToWhitelist.
